what: Each time the pointer hovers the logo, one of the stacked variations (five Lottie ones — letter shape change, squash, position shuffle, bounce, drop) is picked at random, excluding the one just before, cross-faded with the currently visible logo in .3s, then played from the start. The initial logo does not return after the first hover, and the last variation’s end frame remains.

options.[data-fx-part=main·variant]: Variants layered with the initially visible logo (main) — if a variant has an fxPlay function it is played with that (Lottie: el.fxPlay = () => { anim.goToAndStop(0, true); anim.play(); }). If none, run the inner CSS motion from the start

note: The original parks Lottie on its last frame right after loading, so the end shape is visible during the .3s swap, then it returns to the start and plays — when using Lottie, park it with goToAndStop(totalFrames - 1) after loading. Not applied on touch devices.

from.where: shared.js logo hover (data-logo-trigger — lottie-web variants diff·squish·letters·bump·scroll)
